name: io.github.grc-iit/chronolog-mcp
title: ChronoLog MCP
description: Durable agent memory on ChronoLog contexts: remember, recall, follow and reconcile with explicit completeness.

environmentVariables.name: CHRONOLOG_CHRONICLE
environmentVariables.description: The launcher's chronicle that context names resolve in

environmentVariables.name: CHRONOLOG_MCP_IDENTITY
environmentVariables.description: Stable launcher base slot; writable tools need it

environmentVariables.name: CHRONOLOG_MCP_SESSION_ID
environmentVariables.description: The launcher's run session id; fresh when unset

environmentVariables.name: CHRONOLOG_MCP_HOST_ID
environmentVariables.description: Host id recorded in acquisition records; defaults to the hostname

environmentVariables.name: CHRONOLOG_MCP_LOCK_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory of the host-local slot locks
